newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.5 lower vs dlr at 1,056.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.5 lower vs dlr at 1,056.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.5 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,056.00 in brisk trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They cited demand for U.S. currency by banks and the public sector as among factors that conspired to put downward pressure on the peso throughout most of the session.
Dealers reported 420 trades for a total of $179.9 million and said the peso moved in a 1,053.70 to 1,057.20 range against the dollar.
